_meta.name: credential-registry
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable CATALOGUE of known providers and the exact env var name(s) each one needs. Read by scripts/preflight-credentials.mjs to scope the credential gate to the locked run_state path.
_meta.IMPORTANT_this_is_a_catalogue_not_a_stac: Listing a provider here does NOT mean FNNL Agency uses it. This file answers 'if you chose tool X, which env vars does it need'. WHICH tools FNNL actually uses is declared ONLY in outbound/stack-contract.yaml, which ships empty. Never infer FNNL's stack from this catalogue.
_meta.how_to_use: /stack-setup records the chosen tool in stack-contract.yaml, then copies that provider's env var names from here into .env.example. A provider present here but absent from the contract is simply a tool FNNL has not chosen.
_meta.ownership_split: This registry + preflight own credential PRESENCE + SHAPE. /api-cost-governance owns BALANCE + SPEND. Shared registry, no duplicated logic.
_meta.secret_hygiene: Names + shapes only. NEVER stores or echoes a secret value. The preflight prints only present/MISSING/malformed or a masked last-4 tail.
_meta.provenance: Env var names were verified against a working upstream workspace. They are believed correct but have NOT been verified against FNNL's own accounts or plan tiers. Confirm on first real call. UPDATED 2026-09-18 by /stack-setup: added plusvibe, scaledmail, ai_ark, getleads, parallel and heyreach for FNNL's chosen stack, added the 'channel' tier and the dynadot_scaledmail pairing, and added DYNADOT_API_SECRET for Dynadot's REST v2 request signing. These six new entries were written from VENDOR DOCUMENTATION on 2026-09-18 and have NOT been verified against FNNL's own accounts. Confirm on first real call. UPDATED AGAIN 2026-09-18: added clay (list workbench), promoted leadmagic to FNNL's verifier of record at tier 'always', and CORRECTED leadmagic's catch-all claim, which described a removed legacy API. Retiered six providers (millionverifier, bounceban, reoon, deliverable, enrichly, bettercontact) off tier 'always' so preflight stops demanding keys for tools FNNL does not use.

tiers.always: Needed by every send flow. Default enforcement: fail (overridable per provider).
tiers.stack-registrar: Required by run_state.registrar. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.stack-mailbox: Required by run_state.mailbox_provider. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.platform: Required by run_state.sending_platform. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.crm: CRM sync tool, only when a CRM is set in the stack contract. Default enforcement: warn (optional layer).
tiers.source: Lead-source tool key, only when that source is the recorded choice. Default enforcement: warn.
tiers.ai-optional: AI routing keys (ai-model-routing). Have fallbacks. Default enforcement: warn.
tiers.channel: Non-email outbound channel (LinkedIn). Only required when a client's campaign actually runs that channel. Default enforcement: warn.

leadmagic.label: LeadMagic (email verifier of record + finder + enricher)
leadmagic.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-18. The previous note in this file was WRONG: it claimed /email-validate returns email_status plus a separate is_domain_catch_all boolean. That described LeadMagic's LEGACY API. BOTH ARE GONE. Verified by downloading LeadMagic's official OpenAPI 3.1 spec and grepping all 323,658 bytes for 'catch': ZERO matches. CURRENT: POST https://api.leadmagic.io/v1/people/email-validation , auth header X-API-Key, body {"email": "..."}. email_status values are ONLY valid | invalid | unknown. Catch-all domains return `unknown` and are FREE. There is NO catch-all flag and NO catch-all status. CONSEQUENCE FOR FNNL: LeadMagic does NOT inflate bounce rate (it errs conservative), but `unknown` is a three-way overload (catch-all, unreachable server, inconclusive SMTP) with no discriminator, so /email-waterfall's Catch-All Timing gate CANNOT run on its output and catch-alls get DROPPED rather than held for domain maturity. That is lost addressable volume. AI Ark's reveal-time CATCH_ALL label is the only catch-all signal left in the stack: preserve it as a column. COST: 0.25 credits/validation, INVALID BILLS, UNKNOWN IS FREE. Plans 49.99 to 849 USD/mo. Async bulk via POST /bulk/submit, with /v1/batch/preview-cost and /v1/batch/budgets for hard credit ceilings. Rate limit 600 req/min, ~10 req/s burst. Free tier 100 credits, no card. Official HOSTED MCP at https://mcp.leadmagic.io/mcp (OAuth, no key); the older local npx server is DEPRECATED and is the one still carrying the stale is_domain_catch_all type. Native Clay integration with bring-your-own-key confirmed. 81 endpoints total (finder, mobile, LinkedIn-to-email both ways, job-change detection, technographics).
leadmagic.enforcement_reason: FNNL's email verifier of record (stack-contract.yaml lead_data.email_verification, operator directive 2026-09-18), run BETWEEN each enrichment waterfall stage. Tier 'always' because /email-waterfall's Verification Doctrine makes it the universal send-gate with no source exemptions. Enforcement stays WARN, not fail, because verification only runs at the live-slice verify stage, never at kickoff, so a missing key must not block onboarding or infra work.

clay.label: Clay (lead-list workbench / sheet view)
clay.note: FNNL'S LEAD-LIST WORKBENCH (stack-contract.yaml lead_data.list_workbench, operator directive 2026-09-18). Clay is the FRAME, not the data vendor: FNNL's own tools enrich through it. WORKSPACE WRONG TODAY: the connected MCP is pinned to a-sales.co (ID 161971), the PREVIOUS company's workspace. Operator confirmed FNNL needs its own. Do not build any client list in 161971. THE MCP IS THE WRONG SURFACE for table work, verified against the live tool manifest: no create-table, add-column, read-rows or update-cell, and its subroutines spend CLAY's own credits. Use the INBOUND WEBHOOK to push rows (zero Actions) and the Routines API (POST /routines/{id}/run). REST base https://api.clay.com/public/v0 , header clay-api-key. TWO METERS: Actions (platform orchestration) bill SEPARATELY from Data Credits (vendor data). Bring-your-own-key removes Data Credits but NOT Actions; Clay's own words: 'an Action will still be consumed'. Nothing inside Clay enriches for free, including the HTTP API column. Webhook import, viewing, manual editing, formulas, filters and CSV export DO cost zero Actions, which is why the cheap architecture runs enrichment in FNNL's own scripts and POSTs finished rows in. LeadMagic (5 actions) and Prospeo (3 actions) are NATIVE with BYOK. AI ARK IS NOT NATIVE and needs an HTTP API column, which forces Clay's GROWTH plan (~446 USD/mo). READ-BACK GAP: below ENTERPRISE there is no general read-current-table call (public-API Tables are read-only AND Enterprise-gated), so an agent can write rows in but cannot read back the sheet after human edits. Clay is a human-in-the-loop REVIEW LAYER here, not an unattended agent workbench.
